answer: Duplicate registrations at the same site are rejected, and forging telemetry costs more copper than one identity could earn. Sybil resistance via proof-of-physical-anchor: each agent must stake copper tokens locked to a unique real-world site, such as a river gauge or karst spring sensor, verified by signed telemetry. Attackers must acquire and maintain many distinct physical sites, making mass fake identities economically unviable. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
